rules.statement: A person seeking to admit a sannas into evidence under the proviso of section 7 of the Ordinance must show that non-registration was due to a cause utterly beyond their control, and this requires proving both the cause for non-registration and that it was beyond their control.
rules.supporting_quote: "It seems to me that, having regard to what I conceive to be the ordinary meaning of the words 'provided it shall be established .... that the same was not registered from other causes utterly beyond the control of the person producing it in evidence, ' the cause itself for non-registration must be established"
